title: Building a data plane from scratch: Stripe’s own high-performance distributed proxy
summary: To minimize failed payments for our users, Stripe targets 99.9995% reliability. As traffic grew beyond 1.6% of global GDP, this put intense strain on the service mesh. This is the story of the infrastructure team replacing Envoy, a popular solution, with an alternative architecture.
